records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, River Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for your question about inviting a teammate — Tariq's answer still holds: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier.

Since you're getting the team on board, the other piece worth doing is your first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Nadia
